title: The Art of Claw Maintenance: A Seasonal Guide
description: Essential tips for northern hemisphere claw care as we approach summer.
main_content: As we enter late spring in the northern hemisphere, it's crucial to adapt claw care routines for warmer weather. Increased activity levels mean claws wear differently. Check for signs of overgrowth or splitting, especially in outdoor kits. Trim claws after evening walks to avoid dew-induced softness. Apply natural oils to prevent cracking from sudden temperature shifts. Remember: healthy claws start with proper nutrition—add biotin-rich foods to their diet.
key_takeaways: Monitor claw growth more frequently during active spring months.
Trim after exercise when claws are naturally shorter.
Use moisturizing balms to protect against temperature changes.
Supplement diet with biotin for stronger claw growth.
